title: Decision Frameworks: ADRs & Trade-offs — Request & Control Flow
purpose: Traces the Compute Decision Tree Flow: evaluating workload constraints (statefulness, GPU, long-running processes, traffic burstiness) to arrive at the optimal GCP compute target.
routing_rationale: Decision trees guide engineers through branching criteria to systematically narrow down compute options from 6 candidates to 1 clear winner.

nodes.label: Containerized HTTP API?
nodes.detail: Workload packaged in OCI container; responds to HTTPS requests within 60 minutes.

nodes.label: Scale-to-Zero Required?
nodes.detail: Internal developer tool receives zero requests between 7 PM and 7 AM.

nodes.label: Cloud Run Suitability Check
nodes.detail: No GPU needed, execution < 60 min, containerized -> Direct route to Cloud Run.

steps.title: Constraint Verification
steps.action: Decision tree evaluates container packaging and traffic distribution.
steps.why_traversal: Rapidly filters out unsuitable runtimes like App Engine Standard or bare VMs.

steps.title: Automated Deployment
steps.action: gcloud run deploy executes instantly based on decision tree recommendation.
steps.why_traversal: Fast-tracks development while adhering to enterprise standards.

scenarios.label: 60-Minute Execution Timeout Exceeded
scenarios.root_cause: Workload required 4-hour batch video encoding, exceeding Cloud Run's 60-minute limit.
scenarios.recovery: Re-evaluate decision tree: route long-running batch jobs to Cloud Run Jobs or Cloud Batch.

scenarios.label: Quota exhausted
scenarios.root_cause: A project or regional quota reaches its allocation limit.
scenarios.diverted_path: Requests surface elevated latency, errors, or denied actions.
scenarios.blast_radius: Consumers of the affected resource or dependency.
scenarios.recovery: Reduce load, restore the dependency, and add a tested prevention.

scenarios.label: Dependency unavailable
scenarios.root_cause: A required API or downstream dependency is unavailable.
